reviewPacketStatus: 1 live issue, 3 reviewer approval issues, 2 publication-boundary issues

operatorRequests.operatorAction: Choose one non-mainnet network, one Gate 7 candidate, one ordered burn set, one batch window, and one Expected transaction ID; collect explicit approval scoped only to that identity.
operatorRequests.evidenceToReturn: Approval artifact with Expected transaction ID, network, candidate target, ordered burn set, batch window, approver, timestamp, expiry, and statement that no broader live operation is approved.
operatorRequests.stopCondition: Stop if approval is generic, targetless, missing the Expected transaction ID, not time-scoped, or grants broader signing/broadcast permission.

operatorRequests.phase: 2. Produce non-broadcast aggregate and prebroadcast evidence
operatorRequests.operatorAction: Run the aggregate check in non-broadcast mode using operator-local state inputs, then assemble the completed prebroadcast package without sharing secrets or raw runtime state.
operatorRequests.evidenceToReturn: Aggregate check JSON, completed prebroadcast Markdown, sanitized deployment-state digest, singleton inventory, ordered burn set, /transactions/check PASS, Expected transaction ID, and broadcast: no.
operatorRequests.stopCondition: Stop if the command uses default private runtime DBs, unsanitized deployment state, missing check output, or any submit/broadcast path.

operatorRequests.phase: 3. Validate readiness, policy, and signing prerequisites
operatorRequests.operatorAction: Validate the prebroadcast package and provide readiness, broadcast-policy, signing, and network reconfirmation evidence bound to the same Expected transaction ID.
operatorRequests.evidenceToReturn: prebroadcast:validate PASS, prebroadcast:doctor JSON with zero structural issues, readiness PASS, broadcast policy PASS, live settlement signing PASS, and network reconfirmation artifact.
operatorRequests.stopCondition: Stop on non-zero structural issues, target drift, placeholder targets, unscoped BRIDGE_BROADCAST_ENABLED=true, signer mismatch, or network identity drift.

operatorRequests.operatorAction: Only after explicit approval, run the single scoped live submit and record submission plus observation evidence for the same Expected transaction ID.
operatorRequests.evidenceToReturn: Submitted transaction ID, mempool or node observation, confirmation height, confirmation count, finality evidence, ordered burn set, and proof that submitted ID equals Expected transaction ID.
operatorRequests.stopCondition: Do not run without explicit approval. Stop if submitted transaction ID differs from Expected transaction ID or if any mainnet target is selected.

operatorRequests.operatorAction: Run post-submit reconciliation, update the Gate 7 benchmark evidence, then collect reviewer sign-offs after the linked live evidence exists.
operatorRequests.evidenceToReturn: Post-submit observe Markdown and JSON, finality/reconciliation evidence, completed benchmark evidence, benchmark:validate output, and benchmark owner/security/operator reviewer decisions.
operatorRequests.stopCondition: Stop if reconciliation omits successor boxes or finality, benchmark validation remains BLOCKED, reviewers approve before evidence exists, or production/mainnet/throughput claims broaden.

forbiddenInputs: Do not provide .env values, mnemonics, private keys, wallet material, API keys, node auth tokens, or seed phrases.
Do not provide raw runtime databases, private bridge-state SQLite files, deployment-state dumps, or node data directories.
Do not approve signing, submit, broadcast, deployment, publication, PR, mainnet activity, or production throughput claims through this request.
